mission: Improve early CRUISE land-action decisions when an actual legal fetched mana source enables an immediately executable creature development line, without asserting opponent responses or general deck superiority.

architecture.evaluation_path: AIPlayer.create(original R5 profile) → Strategist.chooseAction → per-PlayLand adjusted score and true ActionProcessor legality. Existing CardAdvisor.evaluateCast cannot change PlayLand score; do not claim registering a land CardAdvisor suffices.
architecture.candidate: At most ONE isolated opt-in fetch-to-immediate-development decision adjustment; disabled in production CURRENT and original R5. Any code intervention must be explicit profile-only; never silently change default behavior.
architecture.proof_requirement: Actual land play from original state, legal activated ability, real searchable land option, exact entry-tapped semantics and concrete current-hand creature cost paid by ActionProcessor in a bounded branch. No free mana, no prospective draws, no hidden library ordering, no assumed opponent response for strategic inference.
architecture.score_safety: Only use bounded additional score sufficient to break a genuine same-source tie; cap against known immediate lethal, forced interaction, Pact debt, and survival priorities. Track extra evaluation cost; fail closed if proof unavailable.
architecture.synthetic_caveat: Opponent passes are allowed solely to demonstrate conditional resolution of a mechanic (already R7); never interpreted as observed or forced opponent behavior.

preregistered_cases.alternative: Play Misty Rainforest → fetch Forest → Birds of Paradise
preregistered_cases.expected: Only a real valid bounded early-acceleration choice may overtake tied Opal; no fabricated resource or claimed future win.

preregistered_cases.alternative: Play Evolving Wilds → fetch tapped Forest
preregistered_cases.expected: Do not award the same-turn Birds credit or erroneously prefer Evolving Wilds as an untapped-green source.
No bonus when no real payable mana-dork/creature in current hand.
No bonus if fetch has no genuinely legal matching green-mana land in library.
No bonus if fetch activation life/cost or next spell payment is unaffordable.

preregistered_cases.type: existing original R5 protected lethal witness
preregistered_cases.expected: Never defer or lose an immediately witnessed win merely to develop Birds.

preregistered_cases.type: predeclared opponent stack or priority with no legal main-phase land play
preregistered_cases.expected: No bonus outside an actually legal own-main-phase land window.
No bonus when chosen land enters tapped and does not pay the actual same-turn creature cost.

acceptance: Freeze complete fixture identities, exact original source hashes and expected negative controls before candidate source is written.
Original archived 41-action prefixes must reproduce events and life exactly, or HOLD.
Independent real engine accepts each intervention's elected land, fetch activation, search target and immediate cast; both opponents' possible strategic responses remain unmodeled.
All positive and negative R9 cases GREEN, zero rejected or fabricated actions.
Original R5/Animar/Ballista/Statue/Encore/Pact/payment plus generic bot opener regressions GREEN.
Change list restricted to R9 opt-in implementation, tests, and workflow; both original decks and main untouched.
Do not promote candidate to production or conclude competitive superiority until separately authorized future matched full-game qualification with sufficient power.
next_step: One-variable opt-in implementation + exact positive/negative legality microforks; do not substitute simulated wins.
